status: trial (10-20 images, docs/clinical/28 section 8); revised after the trial feedback, then frozen as 2.x before the formal batch
changes: 2.0.0 (2026-10-29, docs/clinical/31): clinical labels MA / HG / HEX / CWS; fewer questions; clinical consequence anchored to ICDR, the 4-2-1 rule and DME, with a separate question on clinical relevance; fovea click required (or 'not visible'); image-level question on unlabelled lesions; debrief asks which questions were useful.
notes: Codes are what the analysis reads; labels and help are what the reader sees. Never re-use a code for a different meaning; add a new code instead. Lesion codes map to the dataset classes: ma=MA, hg=HE, hex=EX, cws=SE.
